title: Learn Names and Introductions
summary: Use the core Kreyòl personal pronouns and the patterns for saying who you are and giving your name.

sketchBlocks.title: Mwen, Ou, Li, Nou, Yo
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Kreyòl uses a small set of personal pronouns:

- **Mwen** — I / me
- **Ou** — you
- **Li** — he / she / it
- **Nou** — we / you (plural)
- **Yo** — they

For this module, focus first on **Mwen** and **Ou** because they are the forms you need for a simple introduction.

tryItExercises.hint: Choose the option that correctly applies the pattern.

sketchBlocks.title: Mwen se…
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Mwen se…** to identify yourself:

- **Mwen se Jan.** — I am Jan.
- **Mwen se yon elèv.** — I am a student.

The pattern is short and useful. Learn it as a complete conversational chunk.

tryItExercises.title: Build a new identity sentence
tryItExercises.prompt: Arrange the Kreyòl sentence for “I am Mari.”
tryItExercises.hint: Use Mwen se before the name.

help.hint_1: Use the Kreyòl pattern from this lesson.
help.hint_2: Use the pattern you just learned.

sketchBlocks.title: M rele…
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Another common way to introduce yourself is **M rele…** — “My name is…” / literally, “I am called…”.

- **M rele Mari.**
- **M rele Jan.**

You will practice both **Mwen se…** and **M rele…**.

tryItExercises.title: Give a different name
tryItExercises.prompt: Say “My name is Ana.” in Kreyòl.
tryItExercises.hint: Use M rele before the new name.
